blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover core frames, corrections, phases, CRC/base64 errors, covariance/eigenvector basics, and malformed requests, but do not comprehensively test all instructed behavior such as every calibration revision, mode capping, correction effects, multiple independent runs, restart determinism, resource limits, or the required final executable verification.

deterministic_tests: The verifier performs live apt installation and downloads uv from astral.sh, so success depends on external network/package availability. The tests also do not establish coverage of restart behavior or all numerical edge cases required for deterministic service behavior.

valid_failure_modes: A capable solution can fail because tests/test.sh depends on apt repositories, curl, and an external installer at verification time. This is an environmental/network failure unrelated to the submitted service, and the broad requirements are only partially exercised by the tests.
